overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a strong, research-focused cross-platform social media presence across LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon, totaling 3,580 followers. His content consistently focuses on computational social science, disinformation, coordinated behavior, academic opportunities, and tool releases (like CooRnet v2.0), driving high engagement among academic and professional networks.

contentThemes.description: Sharing new research papers, grant awards, and insights into coordinated inauthentic behavior and information operations.
Updates on computational tools like CooRnet v2.0 developed for social media analysis.
Promoting postdoctoral and PhD research opportunities within the computational social science team.
Announcements about upcoming speaking engagements and discussions on cross-platform disinformation methodologies.

recommendations: Cross-promote content across platforms more dynamically, using visual assets or links to detailed research to boost interactions.
Increase posting frequency on high-engagement platforms like Bluesky to capitalize on the active community interested in computational social science.
Engage with comment threads on LinkedIn and Mastodon to foster deeper discussions around academic findings and hiring posts.

platformInsights.bluesky: Demonstrates the highest average engagement rate (6.14%), driven significantly by high repost rates on publication announcements and student research opportunities.
platformInsights.mastodon: Yields strong engagement relative to audience size (780 followers), particularly when sharing open-source tools and technical methodological updates.
platformInsights.linkedin: Generates the highest absolute volume of engagement (likes and comments), making it the most effective channel for professional milestone announcements and recruitment.
